notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirage Mirror do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate any mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kiora's Follower until end of turn.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability, targeting Mirage Mirror.
Resolve both abilities, untapping the permanent and Mirage Mirror.
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate any mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
